deficiencies.acceptance_check: Sentinel reachability tests plus paired independent/two-round/full-round predictive comparisons.

deficiencies.finding: Holdout is all pauses/unchanged stance; simple baselines match or exceed model.
deficiencies.evidence: Live dissent F1 0.8333; always Varma 0.8889; previous-meeting dissent 0.9474. Saved R1 rate and stance already 8/8; R1 dissent F1 0.8. Uniform guessing probability is not baseline superiority.
deficiencies.remediation: Include persistence, independent, single-agent and fitted comparator baselines; broaden regimes and report clustered paired uncertainty and separate ballot channels.
deficiencies.acceptance_check: Publish all predictions/class counts/effect intervals on clean frozen hikes/holds/cuts panel; show incremental performance before claiming it.

deficiencies.finding: Legal quorum, section attribution and fragmented/status-quo voting rules overstate institutional fidelity.
deficiencies.evidence: Law uses four-person quorum and majority of present/voting; casting provision is 45ZI, publication 45ZL. Six-person restriction, multicandidate median/plurality and neutral fallback are assumptions.
deficiencies.remediation: Correct citations, distinguish full-roster protocol from quorum, justify resolution procedure and carry actual prior stance.
deficiencies.acceptance_check: Primary-source rule audit and valid attendance cases; synthetic aggregation sensitivity; correct casting flags.

deficiencies.finding: Information-flow intervention does not isolate all persuasion paths; wedge and round changes are confounded.
deficiencies.evidence: Varma prior/rebuttal withheld but final rationale reaches Governor. Fabricated SPF signals added after R1. Leave-outs/mutings produce no committee shift; tied case hand-constructed.
deficiencies.remediation: Define simulator-local estimand; separately vary messages, authority, ballot visibility and staff signals; accurately label synthetic forecasts; paired repeated conditions.
deficiencies.acceptance_check: Reachability/exclusion tests and member/committee effect intervals with all nulls retained; external validity evidence before real-MPC causal claims.

deficiencies.finding: Condition traces overwrite, checkpoints ignore experimental identity, and reproduce validates existing research tables.
deficiencies.evidence: Baseline and shock same date/replicate write same path. Logs lack exact prompt/model/receipt/hash metadata; date-only cache accepts prior conditions; replicate seed not wired.
deficiencies.remediation: Immutable condition/content identifiers and provenance manifests; matched cache/checkpoint validation; separate replay and fresh generation.
deficiencies.acceptance_check: No overwrite; input/model/seed mutation changes identity; replay regenerates tables from empty results and fails nonzero on corrupt/missing evidence.

deficiencies.finding: Heuristic scores mislabeled in headline claims; integrity checks and scientific proof claims exceed tested properties.
deficiencies.evidence: Abstract calls 76%/76%/0.68 multi-agent while table calls heuristic; guard accepts F1 .01 and 225 NOT JSON files. Rank and SVD checks do not prove empirical ranking/cognitive diversity.
deficiencies.remediation: Typed semantic reconciliation and provenance validation; track-specific claims; distinguish numerical tests from formal scientific proof.
deficiencies.acceptance_check: Mutation tests reject metric/ballot/track/receipt/JSON corruption; auto-reconcile all reported metrics and parameters.

deficiencies.finding: Fixed comparator parameters and unmatched dissent targets do not establish economic superiority; frontier/novelty comparison incomplete.
deficiencies.evidence: No supplied parameter fitting procedure; Gaussian noise assumed; rational dissent is rate-only. Author's updated version reports 218-meeting backtest. Saved cross-model check inconclusive due 404; OOD scenarios synthetic anchors.
deficiencies.remediation: Calibration-only comparator fitting with uncertainty, aligned outcomes and inputs, strong baselines and versioned literature; narrow contribution claims.
deficiencies.acceptance_check: Clean matched evaluation effect sizes plus explicit novelty matrix; actual unseen regime/roster validation where claimed.

deficiencies.finding: Accepted 35/40-bps schema values crash integration and budget errors are swallowed.
deficiencies.evidence: Controlled 35-bps final response raises ValueError; invalid rate becomes zero and invalid stance accepted unflagged. Budget-stop client invoked 24 times with 24 fallbacks and completed.
deficiencies.remediation: Single action/stance contract, reject or flag coercions, propagate budget/cancellation exceptions and reserve cost before provider launch.
deficiencies.acceptance_check: End-to-end valid historical sizes succeed; corrupt payloads rejected/flagged; budget exhaustion prevents subsequent provider requests.
